release.title: Pinned scratch Neyvia tests a candidate through T16 and T18

inventory.effect: Read every authoritative manual hash, procedure, input, judge and goal check

report.effect: Recheck source hashes and T16/T18 proof bytes before returning releaseGate
report.pre: Run receipt may be absent; absence keeps releaseGate false

adapter-preflight.effect: Run fresh source-bound C8 adapter admission and refusal checks, with the executable driver closure copied and hashed under the D run root.
adapter-preflight.pre: Selected checkout is the isolated nx-int-final worktree; writes confined to D:/NeyviaRuns/INTN; no product, network, or browser action is made.

inspect-release.goal: Read the last report with freshly revalidated evidence; a blocked release is a valid reported outcome

run-adapter-preflight.goal: Execute fresh C8 source-hash, deferred-slot, scoped-input, escape and bounds admission/refusal checks.

args.command: import sys,json; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,"C:/Users/user/Projects/nx-int-final/scripts"); import c8_journey; result=c8_journey.preflight_contract("D:/NeyviaRuns/INTN/c8-cl-preflight"); Path("c8-preflight-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result),encoding="utf-8"); print(result["preflightStatus"])

pitfalls.recovery: Author a source-hash-bound disposable journey or supply its required host; never call the row passed

pitfalls.failure: T16 background action unavailable or user input observed
pitfalls.recovery: Keep the journey blocked; do not silently front the window or replay uncertain effects

pitfalls.failure: Evidence bytes or manual source changed
pitfalls.recovery: Run again against the new explicit candidate and pin

frontier: Only Notes write-and-pin and Settings read-preferences have authored UI bindings initially; all other rows remain release blockers
The runner is exclusively headless until plan 20 C11 provides a verified isolated desktop; T18 browser proof never counts as T16 native proof
Devices, microphone, editor, external model and public release journeys need their actual hosts and separate authority
guidance: Build into .agent_control/C8/build-headless with the local Vite runner and no dependency installation
Exit 0 means every row passed. Exit 2 means the report was saved and release remains blocked

Stable source is archived from Git in a separate scratch directory. Services use separate explicit ports and disposable state. No credentials or NAS are read; no push, merge or public promotion occurs
Headless webPassed counts real rendered browser journeys; releaseGate stays false until every row has both T16 and T18 proof
Parallel journeys use distinct explicitly supplied candidate ports and disposable state; no shared pane state between workers
The Notes/Settings backend scope refuses all child-process and desktop launches; runtime/native checks outside that scope remain blocked
Run scripts/prove_c8_report.py --port 48757 --report scripts/evidence/C8c.json to verify the real HTTP report tool and its failure paths
